Playlist.description: A *playlist* resource represents a YouTube playlist. A playlist is a collection of videos that can be viewed sequentially and shared with other users. A playlist can contain up to 200 videos, and YouTube does not limit the number of playlists that each user creates. By default, playlists are publicly visible to other users, but playlists can be public or private. YouTube also uses playlists to identify special collections of videos for a channel, such as: * uploaded videos * favorite videos * positively rated (liked) videos * watch history * watch later To be more specific, these lists are associated with a channel, which is a collection of a person, group, or company's videos, playlists, and other YouTube information. PlaylistItem.description: A *playlistItem* resource identifies another resource, such as a video, that is included in a playlist. In addition, the playlistItem resource contains details about the included resource that pertain specifically to how that resource is used in that playlist. YouTube uses playlists to identify special collections of videos for a channel, such as: * uploaded videos * favorite videos * positively rated (liked) videos * watch history * watch later To be more specific, these lists are associated with a channel, which is a collection of a person, group, or company's videos, playlists, and other YouTube information. You can retrieve the playlist IDs for each of these lists from the [`channel resource`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/channels) for a given channel. You can then use the [`playlistItems.list`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/list) method to retrieve any of those lists. You can also add or remove items from those lists by calling the [`playlistItems.insert`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/insert) and [`playlistItems.delete`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/delete) methods. For example, if a user gives a positive rating to a video, you would insert that video into the liked videos playlist for that user's channel.

enableContentEncryption.description: This setting indicates whether YouTube should enable content encryption for the broadcast.

monitorStream.description: The monitorStream object contains information about the monitor stream, which the broadcaster can use to review the event content before the broadcast stream is shown publicly.

enableDvr.description: This setting determines whether viewers can access DVR controls while watching the video. DVR controls enable the viewer to control the video playback experience by pausing, rewinding, or fast forwarding content. The default value for this property is true. *Important:* You must set the value to true and also set the enableArchive property's value to true if you want to make playback available immediately after the broadcast ends.

language.description: The language of the caption track. The property value is a BCP-47 language tag.

isEasyReader.description: Indicates whether caption track is formatted for "easy reader," meaning it is at a third-grade level for language learners. The default value is false.

isAutoSynced.description: Indicates whether YouTube synchronized the caption track to the audio track in the video. The value will be true if a sync was explicitly requested when the caption track was uploaded. For example, when calling the captions.insert or captions.update methods, you can set the sync parameter to true to instruct YouTube to sync the uploaded track to the video. If the value is false, YouTube uses the time codes in the uploaded caption track to determine when to display captions.

name.description: The name of the caption track. The name is intended to be visible to the user as an option during playback.

failureReason.description: The reason that YouTube failed to process the caption track. This property is only present if the state property's value is failed.

isLarge.description: Indicates whether the caption track uses large text for the vision-impaired. The default value is false.

isDraft.description: Indicates whether the caption track is a draft. If the value is true, then the track is not publicly visible. The default value is false. @mutable youtube.captions.insert youtube.captions.update

isCC.description: Indicates whether the track contains closed captions for the deaf and hard of hearing. The default value is false.

videoId.description: The ID that YouTube uses to uniquely identify the video associated with the caption track. @mutable youtube.captions.insert

lastUpdated.description: The date and time when the caption track was last updated.

audioTrackType.description: The type of audio track associated with the caption track.

CaptionSnippet.description: Basic details about a caption track, such as its language and name.

channelId.description: The ID that YouTube uses to uniquely identify the channel that published the channel section.

type.description: The type of the channel section.

style.description: The style of the channel section.

position.description: The position of the channel section in the channel.

defaultLanguage.description: The language of the channel section's default title and description.

title.description: The channel section's title for multiple_playlists and multiple_channels.

ChannelSectionSnippet.description: Basic details about a channel section, including title, style and position.

banDurationSeconds.description: The duration of the ban. This property is only present if the `banType` is `temporary`.

bannedUserDetails.description: The details of the user that was banned.

CuepointSchedule.description: Schedule to insert cuepoints into a broadcast by ads automator.

enabled.description: This field is semantically required. If it is set false or not set, other fields in this message will be ignored.

repeatIntervalSecs.description: Interval frequency in seconds that api uses to insert cuepoints automatically.

pauseAdsUntil.description: If set, automatic cuepoint insertion is paused until this timestamp ("No Ad Zone"). The value is specified in ISO 8601 format.

enumDescriptions: Strategy to schedule cuepoints at one time for all viewers.
Strategy to schedule cuepoints at an increased rate to allow viewers to receive cuepoints when eligible. See go/lcr-non-concurrent-ads for more details.
scheduleStrategy.description: The strategy to use when scheduling cuepoints.

id.description: The ID of this abuse report reason.

kind.description: Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string `"youtube#videoAbuseReportReason"`.

snippet.description: The `snippet` object contains basic details about the abuse report reason.

VideoAbuseReportReason.description: A `__videoAbuseReportReason__` resource identifies a reason that a video could be reported as abusive. Video abuse report reasons are used with `video.ReportAbuse`.

ActivityContentDetailsRecommendation.description: Information that identifies the recommended resource.

seedResourceId.description: The `seedResourceId` object contains information about the resource that caused the recommendation.

reason.description: The reason that the resource is recommended to the user.

resourceId.description: The `resourceId` object contains information that identifies the recommended resource.

CommentThread.description: A *comment thread* represents information that applies to a top level comment and all its replies. It can also include the top level comment itself and some of the replies.

kind.description: Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "youtube#commentThread".

snippet.description: The snippet object contains basic details about the comment thread and also the top level comment.

replies.description: The replies object contains a limited number of replies (if any) to the top level comment found in the snippet.

id.description: The ID that YouTube uses to uniquely identify the comment thread.

lastUpdateTimeSeconds.description: The last time this status was updated (in seconds)

configurationIssues.description: The configurations issues on this stream

status.description: The status code of this stream

MembershipsLevel.description: A *membershipsLevel* resource represents an offer made by YouTube creators for their fans. Users can become members of the channel by joining one of the available levels. They will provide recurring monetary support and receives special benefits.

id.description: The ID that YouTube assigns to uniquely identify the memberships level.

snippet.description: The snippet object contains basic details about the level.

kind.description: Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "youtube#membershipsLevelListResponse".

VideoSuggestionsTagSuggestion.description: A single tag suggestion with its relevance information.

tag.description: The keyword tag suggested for the video.

categoryRestricts.description: A set of video categories for which the tag is relevant. You can use this information to display appropriate tag suggestions based on the video category that the video uploader associates with the video. By default, tag suggestions are relevant for all categories if there are no restricts defined for the keyword.

kind.description: Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "youtube#channelSectionListResponse".

eventId.description: Serialized EventId of the request which produced this response.

items.description: A list of ChannelSections that match the request criteria.

exception.description: A list of region codes that identify countries where the default policy do not apply.

allowed.description: The value of allowed indicates whether the access to the policy is allowed or denied by default.

AccessPolicy.description: Rights management policy for YouTube resources.

AvailabilityConfigRegionsConfig.description: Video is available in the specified regions only.

regionIntervals.description: Required. List of regions and time windows where video is available. If a region is specified multiple times, the union of all intervals is used.

PlaylistItemStatus.description: Information about the playlist item's privacy status.

comboCount.description: The number of times the gift has been sent in a row.

hasVisualEffect.description: Whether the gift involves a visual effect.

altText.description: The alternative text to be used for accessibility.

giftUrl.description: The URL of the gift image.

language.description: The BCP-47 language code of the gift.

jewelsAmount.description: The value of the gift in jewels.

LiveChatGiftDetails.description: Details about the gift event, this is only set if the type is `giftEvent`.

channelId.description: The YouTube channel ID.

fhd.description: The full high definition (1080p) quality image for this resource.

medium.description: The medium quality image for this resource.

default.description: The default image for this resource.

high.description: The high quality image for this resource.

shortsAspectRatio.description: The Shorts aspect ratio (9:16) image for this resource.

uhd.description: The ultra-high resolution (4K) quality image for this resource.

standard.description: The standard quality image for this resource.

qhd.description: The quad high definition (1440p / 2K) quality image for this resource.

maxres.description: The maximum resolution quality image for this resource.
